newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MILAN'S BOBAN MAY GO TO MANCHESTER, NEWSPAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MILAN'S BOBAN MAY GO TO MANCHESTER, NEWSPAPER SAYS.

text.p: AC Milan and Croatia midfielder Zvonimir Boban is likely to join Manchester United at the end of the season, the Gazzetta Dello Sport said on Friday.
The newspaper said the English champions had reportedly offered $8.75 million dollars for the 28-year-old Croatia captain, now in his sixth season in Italian soccer.
It said Milan were interested in Atletico Madrid's Czech midfielder Radek Bejbl as a replacement.
Although Milan have refused to confirm the speculation, sources close to the club have suggested for some time that Boban would be leaving at the end of this season.
Boban has expressed an interest in playing in England.
Bought by Milan from Dinamo Zagreb in November 1991, Boban played half a season at Bari where his team mates included Brazilian striker Joao Paulo and England midfielder David Platt.
Boban moved to Milan in the summer of 1992 and has scored 11 goals in 102 serie A games over the last six seasons.
